title: Case 016: Disputed Direct Debit amount
initial_request: I want H&V to investigate the £18.40 Direct Debit charge to Northmere Water Services because I dispute the amount debited.
overview: Tamsin Rook saw a £18.40 Direct Debit charge in H&V’s secure portal and, after passing the bank’s identification checks on a call, asked for it to be investigated. The agent registered the specific charge for review, and H&V confirmed the case registration. The charge’s basis and any refund remain unresolved.

next_action.summary: The agent’s immediate step was to register a review of the specific £18.40 Direct Debit charge with the Direct Debit team.

outcome: The review request was registered as HV-016. The charge’s validity and eligibility for a refund have not been determined.

events.body: Statement activity: Direct Debit to Northmere Water Services — £18.40, dated 9 July 2025.
I passed your identification checks, and no secrets were transcribed. I dispute the amount debited: “I dispute the amount debited.” Please have the Direct Debit team investigate this £18.40 charge.
I am registering a review of the £18.40 Direct Debit charge to Northmere Water Services dated 9 July 2025. The customer’s inline statement is: “I dispute the amount debited.”
Case journal status: Review request for the £18.40 Direct Debit charge registered under reference HV-016.
We have registered your request to review the £18.40 Direct Debit charge. Your reference is HV-016; registration does not determine whether the amount was due or whether a refund is available.
